sub_fields.label: Headline
sub_fields.name: headline
sub_fields.instructions: Plain-text headline. For the RetailNext-style partnership slide, still fill this in as a plain-text equivalent (used as a fallback/aria-label) even though the on-screen treatment uses the co-branding lockup below instead. Kept under 140 characters — itoi_hero_headline_size_class() (front-page.php) shrinks the font as length grows through 4 tiers, but there's no tier past 110 chars; a much longer headline will wrap awkwardly and blow out the hero's height rather than degrade gracefully.

sub_fields.label: This is a co-branding / partnership slide
sub_fields.name: is_partnership

sub_fields.label: Partner name

sub_fields.label: Partner logo
sub_fields.name: partner_logo
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. TODO(photo)-style empty state — no RetailNext logo asset exists in this environment yet, so this slide currently renders text-only ("RetailNext × iTOi Solutions", styled). Upload a real logo here to switch the lockup to logo+wordmark once available.

sub_fields.label: Background photo
sub_fields.name: photo
sub_fields.instructions: Optional, per slide. Shown as this slide's background while it's active, behind the Live Detection markers (which keep drawing on top regardless — CLAUDE.md's signature-layer rule). Leave empty to keep the plain dark-gradient look for this slide. Also used as the background video's poster frame and as the still fallback when a visitor has "reduce motion" turned on, if a background video is set below. TEMPORARY: may currently hold a free-licensed stock photo/video-poster frame from the site-wide stock sourcing pass (see NOTES.md) standing in until real ITOI footage exists — check the attachment's caption in Media Library for source + license, and replace before launch. Minimum 1600x900 (2026-08-05, "10/10" pass) — this fills the full-bleed hero background up to desktop widths; a smaller image would visibly upscale/blur. Only enforced on new uploads, doesn't affect an already-selected image.

sub_fields.label: Background video
sub_fields.name: video
sub_fields.instructions: Optional, per slide. Takes priority over the photo above if both are set — muted, autoplay, loops while this slide is active. Never plays for a visitor with "reduce motion" turned on (the photo above, or the plain gradient if no photo is set, shows instead). Keep the file small — a compressed .mp4, a few seconds looping cleanly, no audio track needed since it's always muted. TEMPORARY: may currently hold a free-licensed stock video from the site-wide stock sourcing pass (see NOTES.md) standing in until real ITOI footage exists — check NOTES.md for the source/license, and replace before launch. Max 25MB (2026-08-05, "10/10" pass) — generous headroom above the largest real hero video currently in use (~16.5MB, see docs/performance-baseline.md), but still a real guardrail against an accidentally-uncompressed upload. Only enforced on new uploads.

fields.label: Mega menu — category previews
fields.name: mega_menu_previews
fields.instructions: Right-column preview content for the full-screen mega menu (header.php), one row per top-level Primary menu item, in the same order as Appearance → Menus → Primary. Shown when that item is hovered/focused on the left. Row count must match the Primary menu's actual top-level item count exactly — front-page.php's rendering is index-matched (row 1 = menu item 1, etc.), not matched by label. min/max relaxed 2026-08-05 (was a hard 5,5) after PROJECT.md's own "Products admin" addendum flagged that the Primary menu grew past 5 items without this field ever being widened, silently misaligning every preview after the insertion point. Add/remove rows here to match Appearance → Menus → Primary whenever a top-level item is added, removed or reordered — there is no automatic sync between the two.

fields.label: Proof stats
fields.name: proof_stats
fields.instructions: Homepage "proof" stat tiles — replaced the old client-logo scroller (2026-07-30, see NOTES.md — numbers read as stronger credibility signals than logos). "Facial recognition accuracy" and "Detection speed" below are already-confirmed real figures (PROJECT.md §6). The 3rd row was 'Sites protected' with an unconfirmed '500+' figure, published with no visible TODO(metric) marker despite this note already flagging it as placeholder — replaced 2026-08-05 with a precise capability statement ('Multi-site protection & reporting') instead. Same rule applies to any future edit here: a real, sourced number is fine, an invented one is not — use a capability statement instead if no real figure exists yet.

fields.label: Trust & credibility — heading
fields.name: trust_section_heading
fields.instructions: Homepage "Trust & credibility" section, directly below the mega-hero (front-page.php, id="trustCredibility") — the four large metric cards + real client-logo marquee. Separate from proof_stats above (that section sits lower on the page, dark-glass tiles).
fields.default_value: Trusted by teams who measure performance, not guesswork.

fields.label: Trust & credibility — metrics
fields.name: trust_metrics
fields.instructions: Exactly 4 metric cards by design (min/max both set to 4) — the section's grid assumes exactly four; adding/removing requires a template/CSS change, not just content edits. If a stat_value starts with a digit, its leading number animates (counts up) when the card scrolls into view — see initTrustMetricsCounters() in assets/js/main.js (note: as of 2026-08-05 this always renders the final value immediately with no count-up animation, external improvement plan Phase 3.4 — the digit-detection logic itself is unchanged, just no longer animated). The 4 defaults below are 2 real confirmed figures (PROJECT.md §6: facial recognition accuracy, detection speed) plus 2 capability statements — the separate "PROOF" stat-tiles section that used to hold those 2 real figures lower on the page was cut 2026-08-05 (see NOTES.md) and its real numbers moved up here so this is the single proof section carrying both, not two sections repeating similar content.

sub_fields.label: Value
sub_fields.name: stat_value
sub_fields.instructions: e.g. "100+", "Millions", "Real-time". If this starts with a digit, the leading number animates (counts up) on scroll-in and any trailing text (+, %, /7, " hour") is appended after the count finishes; non-numeric values just render as-is with no count-up.

sub_fields.label: This is a real, verified figure
sub_fields.name: is_verified_stat
sub_fields.instructions: Added 2026-08-05 ("10/10" pass, see NOTES.md) as a real editorial checkpoint, not a display toggle — CMS-only, doesn't change anything on the front end. Check this only for a genuine, sourced number (PROJECT.md §6's do-not-invent list, or a figure a content owner has independently confirmed). Leave unchecked for a capability statement (e.g. "Multi-site reporting") that isn't really a statistic — those don't need verifying, they're not claiming a number. A reviewer should treat an unchecked box on a numeric-looking Value as a reason to double-check before publishing, not as a hard rule enforced by code.
